episodes.title: Episode One: The Collywobbles
episodes.summary: Amanda Waller sends the newly forged Creature Commandos to the small European enclave of Pokolistan to protect Princess Ilana Rostovic and her country's most valuable assets from Circe and the Sons of Themyscira.

episodes.title: Episode Two: The Tourmaline Necklace
episodes.summary: While Ilana continues her pursuit of Flag, The Bride shows Nina the place where she was created. As the manor triggers memories of Frankenstein's disastrous pursuit over the years, The Bride and Nina find themselves under attack by Circe and the Sons.

episodes.title: Episode Three: Cheers to the Tin Man
episodes.summary: As the team attempt to save The Bride and Nina, GI Robot relives his glory days and finally gets his wish.

episodes.title: Episode Four: Chasing Squirrels
episodes.summary: The Creature Commandos return home in hopes of understanding Circe's motivations. While his lawyer tries to coax him for answers, Weasel reflects on the events that landed him in Belle Reve in the first place.

episodes.title: Episode Five: The Iron Pot
episodes.summary: Frankenstein is nursed to health by a new friend. Later, Flag and Frankenstein team up to disprove Circe's visions about the Princess.

episodes.title: Episode Six: Priyatel Skelet
episodes.summary: Amid Alex's struggle to satisfy those bankrolling his research, Dr. Phosphorus is born. Meanwhile, the Creature Commandos attempt to carry out their directive - and not be killed in the process.

episodes.title: Episode Seven: A Very Funny Monster
episodes.summary: Nina's birth proves unexpectedly complicated for her parents. Meanwhile, Flag and the Amethyst Knights do whatever it takes to stop the Creature Commandos from killing the Princess.
